what.text: This page follows refugees from Mali living in Burkina Faso, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 40103 Malian refugees in Burkina Faso, 7.7% of all refugees from Mali.
Mauritania hosts the most Malian refugees, followed by the Niger, Burkina Faso and Spain.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Azawad territory in Mali in some years from 1990 to 2015, with the CMA in 2012 and from 2014 to 2015.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Mali from 2012 to 2025, with Ansar Dine, AQIM and MUJAO among the opponents, and with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 5400 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 49500, at the end of 1994, and the main years of displacement in the data include 1994, 2012 to 2016 and 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Burkina Faso.
These are year-end totals for Burkina Faso only, reported to UNHCR.
